description: Two controlled experiments on the MemoryForge Hopfield-style associative memory: (1) patterns fixed, noise increased; (2) generation method fixed, memory load (number of stored patterns) increased. Multiple seeds and targets were used in both.

findings.noiseExperiment: With patternCount fixed at 4, exact recall is 100% reliable for noise <= 30%, drops sharply to 40% success at 40% noise, and fails completely (0%) at 50% noise. Networks always converge (100% of runs), so failures are convergence to a stable but wrong (spurious or inverted) state, not non-convergence.
findings.memoryLoadExperiment: With noise fixed at 20%, exact recall is 100% reliable for pattern counts <= 4, degrades to 90% at 8 patterns, drops sharply to 40% at 12 patterns, and mostly fails (10%) at 16 patterns -- consistent with the classical Hopfield capacity limit of roughly 0.14N patterns for N=64 neurons (~9 patterns).

success.label: selected-success
success.reason: Demo preset: 4 stored patterns, 20% noise on the cue. This exact (patternCount=4, noisePercent=20) configuration achieved 100% exact recall across all 20 sampled seed/target combinations in the noise experiment (see noiseBreakdown), so any seed reproduces the same outcome -- it is not a cherry-picked single run. The instance shown here uses seed=11, target=random-11 so it can be shown back-to-back with the paired failure example below (same seed/target/patternCount, only noise differs).
success.reliability: 20/20 exact recalls (100%) across all seeds and targets at this configuration

failure.label: selected-failure
failure.reason: Demo preset: 4 stored patterns, 50% noise on the cue. This exact (patternCount=4, noisePercent=50) configuration produced 0 exact recalls out of 20 sampled seed/target combinations in the noise experiment (see noiseBreakdown) -- every run at this noise level converges to the wrong (spurious) state, so the failure is fully reliable, not a one-off unlucky seed. The instance shown here uses the same seed=11, target=random-11, patternCount=4 as the success example above -- only the noise level changes, isolating the effect of noise for the demo.
failure.reliability: 0/20 exact recalls (0%) across all seeds and targets at this configuration

success.label: selected-success
success.reason: Exact recall with convergence; selected as a clean reliable success example.

failure.label: selected-failure
failure.reason: Failed exact recall; selected because it produced the lowest cell accuracy among measured runs.
